    SELECT 
        s.student_id,
        s.name,
        AVG(sc.attendance_percentage) AS avg_attendance,
        SUM(sc.credits_obtained) AS total_credits
    FROM students s
    JOIN student_courses sc ON s.student_id = sc.student_id
    WHERE s.status = 'Active'
    GROUP BY s.student_id
),
DepartmentPerformance AS (
    SELECT 
        d.department_id,
        AVG(s.cumulative_gpa) AS avg_gpa
    FROM departments d
    JOIN students s ON d.department_id = s.department_id
    WHERE s.status = 'Active'
    GROUP BY d.department_id
),

    SELECT 
        s.student_id,
        s.roll_number,
        vec.distance AS name_similarity
    FROM students s
    JOIN (
        SELECT rowid, distance 
        FROM students 
        WHERE name_embedding MATCH lembed('all-MiniLM-L6-v2',"John Doe, Computer Science Department")
        ORDER BY distance 
        LIMIT 5
    ) AS vec ON s.rowid = vec.rowid
)

    sga.student_id,
    sga.total_credits,
    dp.avg_gpa,
    ns.name_similarity
FROM StudentGPAAnalysis sga
JOIN NameSimilarity ns ON sga.student_id = ns.student_id
JOIN students s ON sga.student_id = s.student_id
JOIN DepartmentPerformance dp ON s.department_id = dp.department_id
WHERE dp.avg_gpa > 3.0
ORDER BY ns.name_similarity;

  GROUP BY
    r.drug_id, r.condition_id

  SELECT
    r.drug_id,
    r.condition_id,
    r.review_id,
    r.rating,
    r.useful_count,
